title: Bounded Exec
description: Run one shell command under a no-progress bound or an absolute ceiling, with process-tree cleanup.

cwd.description: Working directory. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root.

env.description: Environment variables made available to the command.

timeoutMs.description: Absolute wall-clock ceiling in milliseconds, for a command that reports no tests. A backstop against an unbounded run, not a performance budget. A test target names idleTimeoutMs instead.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Kill the process tree when no test has finished for this many milliseconds: a nextest status line with its run counter, a bun result line or dot. Output that reports no finished test (a SLOW warning, a heartbeat) is not progress. A command that reports no tests makes progress only by exiting. Omit for no progress bound.

killAfterMs.description: Most milliseconds a timed-out or CPU-grant-revoked command gets after graceful termination before its process group is force-killed. The grace ends early when the command exits; whatever it leaves in its process group is force-killed then.

parallelism.description: Requested threads or processes before inherited runner ceilings: positive NEXTEST_TEST_THREADS and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS cap their respective runners, and configured counts may only lower an inherited ceiling. Omit to let the command decide (nextest and cargo one per core, `bun test --parallel=N` N, anything else one). Runner concurrency is min(bounded request, granted tokens); the actual held grant reaches the command as BOUNDED_EXEC_CPU_TOKENS, with its sub-pool in BOUNDED_EXEC_CPU_POOL.

forwardAllArgs.description: Append unparsed Nx CLI arguments to the command.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the command.
